prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 公司差旅报销标准 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 6 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "费用项目" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 92px
  col 2: header "普通员工" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 170px
  col 3: header "经理" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 223px
  col 4: header "总监" · longest unbreakable word 35px · one-line width 202px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"按费用项目和员工职级查阅公司差旅报销标准。","reading":"读者先沿首列找到费用项目，再横向比较普通员工、经理和总监的标准；也可能沿某一职级向下查阅各项规定。","groups":["第 2、3、4 列都是职级对应的报销标准，应便于横向比较。","第 1 列是费用项目标签，用来识别和区分各行。"],"keep_intact":["金额、计量单位和数字应尽量保持在一起，例如“500 元/晚”和“80 元/日”。","职级表头和费用项目名称应尽量完整，避免拆散难以辨认的词语。"],"may_wrap":["包含早餐、预订或改签条件等说明可在自然语义边界换行。","同一行中较长标准造成的行高可容纳其他职级标准的换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [81, 92, 93, 93] · table 360×521px · row heights [60, 83, 106, 106, 83, 83] · column headers wrapped 1/4 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [81, 91, 91, 96] · table 360×498px · row heights [60, 83, 106, 83, 83, 83] · column headers wrapped 1/4 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [81, 92, 95, 91] · table 360×521px · row heights [60, 83, 106, 106, 83, 83] · column headers wrapped 1/4 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"三个职级列宽接近，横向比较的节奏一致；费用项目与各职级标准的对应关系清楚，未出现单词中间拆分。","problems":"首列表头和多项费用名称换行，行标签不够利落；总监列的高铁条件占四行，导致该行偏高。金额与“晚”等单位也被分到不同行。","cause":"首列宽81px，文本空间不足以完整容纳部分标签；总监列宽93px，高铁条件中的“4小时以上”无法较紧凑地排列。普通员工和经理列分别为92px、93px，住宿金额与单位仍无法完整同排。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"总监列的高铁条件由四行减为三行，整行更紧凑；三个职级列仍保持相近宽度，整体比较关系清楚。","problems":"首列表头和较长费用名称仍换行；住宿金额与“晚”被拆到不同行，经理列的改签说明也被拆成三行。","cause":"首列仍为81px；普通员工和经理列各为91px，可用文本宽度有限。总监列增至96px，刚好改善高铁条件的换行，是三版中较有用的宽度调整。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"经理列略宽，职级列的视觉比例仍较均衡；各行的项目和标准对应明确。","problems":"经理列加宽没有明显改善整体换行，反而使总监列高铁条件回到四行，增加整行高度；首列表头和住宿金额单位仍被拆行。","cause":"经理列增至95px，但总监列缩至91px，无法像r1B的96px那样容纳更紧凑的高铁条件；首列仍为81px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"r2A","widths":[81,88,90,100],"change":"以r1B为基础，保留首列宽度，将部分空间从普通员工列移给总监列。检验更宽的总监列能否改善高铁、住宿和市内交通说明，同时观察普通员工列是否出现明显退化。"},{"name":"r2B","widths":[89,86,87,97],"change":"加宽费用项目列，争取让表头和行标签更完整；总监列维持足以改善高铁条件的宽度，检验较窄的普通员工和经理列是否仍能保持可读。"},{"name":"r2C","widths":[73,92,94,100],"change":"尝试更窄的行标签列，把空间优先分给三列标准，尤其是说明较长的总监列；检验标准内容的换行收益是否足以抵消项目名称可能增加的换行。"}]}
